newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria moves T-bill auction date week ahead.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria moves T-bill auction date week ahead.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry has moved a week ahead the date of an auction of 6.7 billion levs of three-month floater coupon T-bills, initially set for November 4, the central bank (BNB) said.
"The Finance Ministry informed us that the auction date for the issue has been corrected to October 28," a BNB official told Reuters.
The issue date and the maturity date were also moved a week ahead. The other papameters of the issue remained unchanged.
The paper will be offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry.
The coupon was set equal to the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity. The CIR is now set at 20 percent monthly or 240 percent annually.
